Fit a fold-safe preprocessing transform on training data

Source: R/preprocessing.R
stabl_preprocess_fit.Rd

Learns preprocessing parameters from a training matrix only. The result is a "stabl_preprocessing" object that stabl_preprocess_apply() applies to training or assessment data without refitting.

Usage

stabl_preprocess_fit(
  x_train,
  transforms = c("center", "scale"),
  zv_tol = 0,
  ...
)

Arguments

x_train

Numeric training matrix (samples × features) with column names.

transforms

Character vector naming the transforms to fit. Supported: "zv" (zero-variance filter), "impute_median" (median imputation), "center", "scale". Transforms are always applied in the fixed order "zv" -> "impute_median" -> "center" -> "scale", regardless of the order in transforms. NULL or character(0) fits an identity transform that leaves input unchanged.

zv_tol

Non-negative numeric; a feature whose training variance is <= zv_tol is removed by "zv".

...

Reserved for future use.

Value

A "stabl_preprocessing" object recording the fitted parameters, the retained feature names, and the feature mapping.

Examples

x <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 5), 40, 5,
            dimnames = list(paste0("s", 1:40), paste0("f", 1:5)))
pp <- stabl_preprocess_fit(x, transforms = c("center", "scale"))
xt <- stabl_preprocess_apply(pp, x)
